section_path_text: More Or Less To The Med
summary:
Iraqi deal with Kurds will raise exports through Ceyhan
On Friday, 16 November 2018, the Government of Iraq restarted exports of Kirkuk crude oil through the Iraq - Turkey pipeline. Initial volumes flowing through the pipeline average 50,000 barrels per day (b/d). The target is to achieve 100,000 b/d in the coming weeks with the potential for significantly more in the future.
